title: Number of Recent Calls
goal: Count requests in each inclusive trailing 3000-unit window.
strategy: Increasing timestamps let the oldest-valid pointer move only forward. A request exactly 3000 units old still counts.

phasePurposes.start: Count requests in each inclusive trailing 3000-unit window.
phasePurposes.inspect: Increasing timestamps let the oldest-valid pointer move only forward. A request exactly 3000 units old still counts.

phasePurposes.done: Count requests in each inclusive trailing 3000-unit window.

edgeCases: Large gaps remove every prior call
inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.
